effects.label: Harden
effects.description: Decreases the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

bio: In the early days of the Dusklit, they were hunted ruthlessly by Night Lords, vampires set on avenging the Dusklit’s betrayal of Malice. To protect their people, the Nocturna Invokers created an unstoppable beast of bloodless stone. Gargoth was the last thing each of the Night Lords ever saw.
